summary: New Horizon Aircraft Ltd. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to decrease the maximum offering amount under its at-the-market (ATM) sales agreement with JonesTrading from $50 million to $28 million, including previously sold shares. As of May 22, 2026, the last reported sale price was $3.14 per share on Nasdaq. This is a routine shelf takedown amendment involving a reduction in registered shares, not a special-situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is present.
